Sean / Marissa —

Putting together the package now. Quick answers inline for TideHealth: 

- 48-hour external notification: Our preferred standard is 72 hours for notification to customers, but we understand regulated customers may require tighter windows. We maintain incident triage runbooks that support escalation paths enabling notifications within 48 hours when contractualized.

- SOC 2: We can share a controls summary (attached: soc2-summary-2025.pdf) immediately. Full Type II report is available under NDA — we'll include the NDA next steps in the package.

- IR Playbook: attaching redwood-ir-playbook.pdf (redacted excerpts suitable for customer review) — includes detection, containment, remediation, and notification templates. The playbook maps roles (SRE / Security / Customer Ops) and sample notification timelines.

- BCP/DR: attached bcp-sample-templates.zip — includes sample RTO/RPO tables. For Hosted customers we target RTO: 2–8 hours for regional failovers depending on model size / stateful features; RPO: near-zero for stateless inference paths, and up to 15 minutes for model state cache recovery in typical setups. Dedicated customers can negotiate stricter RTO/RPO in their SLA.

- Vendor SQ: converted their xlsx intake into our tracker format and attached vendor-sq-tidehealth.xlsx.

I'll also include a short cover note on how we map HIPAA controls to SOC 2 criteria for quick review.
